technique_name: Suggest a creative solution to a rising problem in your school or community.
description: One creative solution to the problem of rising dropout rates in my school or community is to create a youth mentoring program. This program would pair mentors with at-risk youth in order to provide consistent guidance and support. The mentors could help with goal-setting, provide academic assistance, and serve as role models that the youth can look up to.
